queries: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg FROM per_transaction p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_kept FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_anlycount, k.avg_anlycount - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_anlycount - ka.avg_kept AS above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_average ka ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST, k.transref ASC LIMIT 10

WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, p.avg_anlycount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM per_transaction AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall, avg_anlycount - AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS above_kept FROM kept ORDER BY above_kept DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS average_analyst_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_analyst_count) AS overall_average FROM transaction_averages), kept AS (SELECT t.transref, t.average_analyst_count, o.overall_average FROM transaction_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.average_analyst_count > o.overall_average), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_analyst_count) AS average_among_kept FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.average_analyst_count, k.average_analyst_count - k.overall_average AS above_overall_average, k.average_analyst_count - a.average_among_kept AS above_kept_average FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_average AS a ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC NULLS LAST, k.transref LIMIT 10;
